task_goal: Land the rocket safely on the pad at coordinates (0,0) minimizing fuel consumption and time.
termination_modes: Lander body crashes into moon surface
success_like_ending: Both legs in contact with ground (state[6] == 1.0 and state[7] == 1.0)
Position within landing pad bounds (abs(state[0]) < threshold)
failure_like_endings: Lander body crashes into moon surface

behavior_trajectory_prior.goal: Counteract initial random force and align vertical axis.
Reduce altitude while maintaining horizontal position near pad.
Achieve zero velocity at contact with both legs on the pad.

reward_design_risks.name: Infinite Hovering
reward_design_risks.description: Agent hovers indefinitely to avoid crash penalty without landing.

reward_design_risks.name: Crash Avoidance via Escape
reward_design_risks.description: Agent flies out of bounds intentionally if boundary exit is less penalized than crash.

reward_design_risks.name: Oscillation
reward_design_risks.description: Agent oscillates near pad without committing to landing due to sparse reward.
